description: This file is a script for benchmarking CLI startup performance, comparing current results against a baseline fixture, and reporting regressions in duration and memory usage.

methods.name: formatMs
methods.description: Formats a number as a string with one decimal place and 'ms' suffix.

methods.name: formatMb
methods.description: Formats a number as a string with one decimal place and 'MB' suffix.

methods.name: resolveCurrentReportPath
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the path to the current benchmark report, executing the benchmark process if necessary.

methods.name: indexCases
methods.description: Creates a map of report cases keyed by their ID.
